Container.Name: Tofarr
Container.Overview: Creates Tofa custom collections from TMDB collections/lists, TMDB discover rules (actor, genre, studio), Trakt lists or a manual list of TMDB ids, and keeps them in sync on a schedule. Includes a web UI with a dry-run preview before anything is written, and lists titles that are not in your Tofa library yet. Setup: open the web UI, go to Settings and enter your server URL and an admin API key (the TOFA_URL / TOFA_API_KEY variables below are optional defaults). Create the key in Tofa under Server > Settings > API keys and set TOFA_URL to the direct address of your server (not the relay). A free TMDB API key is needed for TMDB sources.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 8080.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (collection definitions and run history) is stored.

Config.Name: TOFA_URL
Config.Description: Direct address of your Tofa server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:33333 (API keys do not work through the relay).

Config.Name: TOFA_API_KEY
Config.Description: Admin API key from Tofa Server > Settings > API keys (shown once when created).

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Free API key from themoviedb.org/settings/api. Needed for TMDB collection, list and discover sources.

Config.Name: TRAKT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Client ID of a Trakt app (trakt.tv/oauth/applications). Needed for Trakt list sources.

Config.Name: SEERR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of your Seerr, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5055. Lets you request titles you do not have.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Seerr API key (Seerr, Settings, General).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, used for run timestamps.
